workshoptitle: Oracle Integration 3 - Govern AI Agent Access with Oracle Integration MCP Gateway

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Expose Integrations as MCP Tools and Register MCP Servers
tutorials.description: Turn CRM integrations into MCP tools, enable the project MCP server, and register Oracle Integration and third-party MCP servers.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Validate Tool Requests with Business Policies
tutorials.description: Generate JavaScript business rules with AI Assist to reject malformed customer IDs.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Restrict Tools and Protect PII with Security Policies
tutorials.description: Hide a high-risk tool with tool filters and mask PII in responses.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Create and Activate the MCP Gateway
tutorials.description: Attach servers and policies to a gateway, order the pipelines, and activate it.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Test the Gateway from an MCP Client and Monitor Activity
tutorials.description: Connect MCPJam Inspector, run allowed and denied prompts, and trace activity in Observe.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to Common Problems and Directions for Receiving Live Help
